claim_one_line: THE DEPARTURE'S DEPTH: THE ACTION SELECTS WITHIN A PREMISE, THE PREMISE IS A CHARGE [dated note 2026-11-11, carrying B1862's correction (the audit's E3): two cases stand under that word -- E = +I, invisible to every state, and E = -I, invisible only under a parity superselection rule; 338 and 305 of the 643] (the explore seat's two relays, verified on main's own code): among R1's 643 rung-invisible defects the least Mostow-rigid excess volume is (6), uniquely (1.5714462325; next 2.1955011599), and among the 3494 line-invisible, (2,1,1,1,2) -- both as least length; the line premise is exactly the symmetry reading (C5(LR) = <LR>, order 10) and the rung premise at level N exactly the charge reading (only +-I conserve every golden background's class, N = 2..5); the least-length ladder (2), (2,1,1,1,2), (6), (21), (61) over R1 u R2, each unique; the apex law (n - 1)/2 + sqrt5/2 exact; LR fixes a point of P^1(Z/N) only at N = 5. The depth rests on the premise (a superselection charge at 5) and on minimisation (the volume sum diverges); the charge law depth = lcm(S)/2 + sqrt5/2 a range-scoped candidate (P-737); the ramified-prime speculation a LEAD (P-738). Nothing compared with data. 0 of 19. [CORRECTED by B1855, marked here at Review 77 (2026-11-10): the ladder's last two members, (21) and (61), are minima within R1 u R2 only; outside it gapped defects satisfy the same premises with less excess, so the charge law holds for lcm(S) <= 10 and is refuted for lcm(S) >= 12.]
